ns2:section.sectionText: Here is a chance to network and meet with premier athletic organizations, media companies, and advertising agencies. Experience Portland, Oregon and Seattle Washington. Learn about the culture and careers from industry professionals as well as cutting-edge and emerging organizations. Potential visits include; Nike, Adidas, Under Armor, Google, Columbia, Portland Timbers & Trailblazers, Wieden + Kennedy, R/GA, Downstream, Instrument and more. Trip Date: March 18-23, 2019. Estimated Course Fee: $1,495 (billed to your student account). Scholarships and financial aid may apply. Request Instructor approval at: https://forms.illinois.edu/sec/5405090
